qualification: Canonical structured objective definitions and historical initial state. Current achievement must be demonstrated by later operating records and is not inferred from document approval.

records.objective: Keep every production deployment traceable to reviewed source.
records.metric: Percentage of production deployments that identify immutable commit SHA, semantic tag/release, and deployment evidence.

records.objective: Prevent credentials and secrets from entering public source or public evidence surfaces.
records.metric: Confirmed secret exposures in repository, public logs, health/version, or public evidence.
records.initialTarget: 0 confirmed exposures. Any suspected exposure triggers immediate review and rotation decision.

records.objective: Maintain accountable treatment for material security risks.
records.metric: High/Critical security risks with assigned owner, treatment direction, and review date.

records.objective: Establish and evidence recovery for data and deployable application state.
records.metric: Defined recovery procedure and completed recovery test for in-scope deployable state/data where WizardGang is responsible.
records.initialTarget: Procedure documented and at least one evidenced recovery test by 2026-12-02.

records.objective: Ensure material security events are handled consistently and produce corrective evidence.
records.metric: Material incidents with documented triage, containment/recovery decision, root/contributing-cause review where useful, and follow-up action.
records.initialTarget: 100% of material incidents after process adoption; incident procedure established by 2026-12-02.

records.objective: Maintain visibility of critical platform and dependency risks.
records.metric: Critical suppliers/dependencies with owner, role, risk/applicability rationale, and review evidence.
records.initialTarget: 100% of identified critical suppliers reviewed at least annually and after material supplier change.

records.objective: Keep the public MCP capability within explicitly approved authority.
records.metric: Exposed MCP tools with documented purpose, authorization boundary, and read/write/destructive classification.
records.initialTarget: 100% of exposed MCP tools inventoried and classified; 0 unapproved privileged/write/destructive public tools.

records.objective: Ensure material AI capability changes trigger governance review before release.
records.metric: Material AI changes with documented risk review and, where triggered, updated impact assessment before release.
records.initialTarget: 100% of material AI authority, data, provider, intended-use, or oversight changes.

records.objective: Expand and maintain executable tests for approved and prohibited AI/MCP behavior.
records.metric: Defined AI evaluation cases implemented and passing for current capability.
records.initialTarget: Maintain existing approved-read/unknown-method/invalid-scope cases and add coverage for tool inventory, authorization parity, malformed input, sensitive-field exclusion, and indirect-instruction content by 2026-12-02.

records.objective: Make AI-accessible demo data boundaries and limitations inspectable.
records.metric: AI-facing data surfaces with documented intended data class, provenance/freshness expectations, and limitation statement.
records.initialTarget: 100% of public AI-accessible data surfaces documented; no known sensitive field exposed through public MCP.

records.objective: Maintain accountable treatment for material AI risks.
records.metric: High/Critical AI risks with owner, treatment direction, review date, and linked impact assessment where relevant.

records.objective: Keep management-system evidence current enough to support public assurance claims.
records.metric: Governance records past their required review date without review or explicit extension.
records.initialTarget: 0 critical governance records more than 30 days overdue.
